# pvecli ct tag

Manage container tags.

## add

Add one or more tags to a container.

By default, tags are appended to existing tags.
Use --replace to replace all existing tags.

```text
pvecli ct tag add [CTID] [TAGS] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTID` | Container ID (CTID). |
| `TAGS` | Tag(s) to add (comma-separated). |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-re`, `--replace` | Replace all existing tags instead of appending. |

## remove

Remove one or more tags from a container.

```text
pvecli ct tag remove [CTID] [TAGS] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTID` | Container ID (CTID). |
| `TAGS` | Tag(s) to remove (comma-separated). |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## list

List all tags for a container.

```text
pvecli ct tag list [CTID] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTID` | Container ID (CTID). |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
